canonical_encoding: UTF-8 JSON, sorted keys, no whitespace, nonfinite values forbidden
publication_hash: SHA-256 of canonical publication without publication_id
reference_only: no content or verified excerpt hash; no automatic retrieval
ordering: supersedes only; import time never selects latest scientific truth
timestamps: ISO 8601 with timezone; unknown event/record/availability is null
trust: trusted receiver grant plus admitted import root, outside the publication
